targets.evidence_quote: The present report is the second large-scale validation study of the PDSQ in psychiatric out-patients. Because some of the sizes of the diagnostic groups in the initial report were modest, it is important to determine whether the recommended cut-off scores to screen for psychiatric disorders remained the same in a replication study.
targets.outcome_quote: Based on receiver operating curve analysis, the PDSQ performed as well in the replication sample as in the initial validation study.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract explicitly compares overall diagnostic performance with the initial validation and says it performed as well. A count of unchanged cutoff scores does not by itself overturn that overall comparison. The abstract gives no citation identifying the initial validation paper; bibliographic fields are left empty.
